inlines.v: CHILL, noun 1. A shivering with cold; rigors, as in an ague; the cold fit that precedes a fever; sensation of cold in an animal body; chilliness. [See Cold and Heat.] 2. A moderate degree of cold; chilliness in any body; that which gives the sensation of cold.
